verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents a first-party CLI command, `edge0 serve edge0-35b`, that starts a local OpenAI-compatible server on 127.0.0.1:8000, which covers the 'start' half of the story. A macOS CLI/daemon is also listed, but nothing documents how to stop the server or manage its lifecycle from the command line. Missing for 10: a documented stop/shutdown command or daemon lifecycle controls (start/stop/status), detail on the macOS daemon's management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line
